note: The six clamp cases, MEASURED 2026-08-05 on Drools/KIE 8.44.0.Final and
Camunda 8.7.6 (zeebe-dmn): 6/6 on both, zero errors. The same six evaluated
in L4 through daydate's `add months` / `add years` give the same six answers,
which is the equivalence the DMN lowering of those two heads depends on.
Read the fourth case carefully: 28 Feb PLUS one year is 28 Feb, NOT 29 Feb.
Clamping pulls a day BACK to the month end; it never pushes one forward.

cases.name: the clamp, on months and on years
